text: Nuuhu waɗi yamiroore Joomi mun, o woni e lesugol laana kan. Tuma kala nde dental hoorewal yimɓe makko ɓen rewi ɗon, ɓe jalkita mo ko o lesirta laana kan ka leydi ndi alah ndiyam e canɗi. Nde jalkitugol ngol filli-fillini, o maaki: Ko onon yo dental hooreeɓe, si on jalkitii men ka men lesata kaa laana ɗoo, menen kadi men jalkitoyay on majjere mon nden tuma nde yooloyteɗon.
